scope: All 13 patterns listed in the NHS digital service manual catalogue, adapted as civica household reference patterns. No NHS branding, patient data or clinical workflow is included.

patterns.source_review_method: Read complete official primary-source guidance, including use, non-use, implementation, accessibility and research sections where present.
patterns.title: Ask for device and entity identifiers
patterns.adaptation_boundary: Identifier interaction only; no NHS or clinical data collection; entity IDs are explicitly renameable.
